title: CNL members arrested over alleged meeting in a bar at Butare trading centre
reason: The contemporaneous monitoring report describes 13 CNL activists sharing drinks in a bar among other customers, arrested on the allegation of an illegal meeting. It documents no public protest, mobilization demand or crowd of at least 50; 13 arrests are below the dataset threshold even if treated as an attendance indicator.
notes: This records a relevant rights/assembly lead without coding the arrests themselves as a protest event. Another alleged bistro meeting has no exact date or count and is not separately coded. The report's call for the government to unlock civic space is the NGO's advocacy, not evidence of a demand made by event participants.
